# apollonian-sandpile-markov (0TH-2026-018, v2.0.0)

> Zero-Mathlib Lean 4.35.0 six-kernel formalization of 16 statements (19 audited declarations) covering HKRS (2024) square obstructions on three Apollonian packings, octahedral mod-8 locking, direct 9x9 Z^2 and A_2 Laplacian determinants & Dhar traces, an elementary A_2 even-Laplacian parity lemma, Zhang's (2007) Markov mod-32 theorem, 5-step Markov quiver identities, and Hurwitz's (1907) n=4 admissible coefficients. No open problem is solved.

## Canonical Files
- [README.md](README.md): Overview, verbatim 5-second Lean axiom audit, quickstart, usage examples
- [CLAIMS.md](CLAIMS.md): Complete theorem-to-declaration claims matrix and open boundaries
- [LIMITATIONS.md](LIMITATIONS.md): Scope limits and 6 concrete falsification criteria
- [VERIFICATION.md](VERIFICATION.md): Six-kernel Lean + negative kernel gate + Rust + C11 ASan/UBSan/libFuzzer + Python/Hypothesis/mutation architecture
- [REPLICATION.md](REPLICATION.md): Clean-clone step-by-step reproduction guide and replication log
- [HARDENING_LOG.md](HARDENING_LOG.md): Multi-cycle hostile audit log across all 10 finding classes
- [UPGRADING.md](UPGRADING.md): SemVer upgrade guide (`v1.0.0 -> v2.0.0`) and deprecation policy
- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): System, formal module, and six-kernel trust architecture
- [docs/configuration.md](docs/configuration.md): Toolchain pins, build options, and CLI reference
- [docs/operations.md](docs/operations.md): Offsite archival mirroring, git bundle recovery, dual timestamps, and rollback
- [docs/reviews/2026-11-26-10-pass-red-team-review.md](docs/reviews/2026-11-26-10-pass-red-team-review.md): Playbook v1.3 10-pass red-team review
